query: 哪些员工的订单总金额高于全体员工的平均订单总金额？

outcome.sql: WITH "emp_order_total" AS (SELECT "o"."emp_id" AS "emp_id", SUM("o"."amount") AS "total_amount" FROM "public"."orders" "o" GROUP BY "o"."emp_id"), "avg_total" AS (SELECT AVG("total_amount") AS "avg_total_amount" FROM "emp_order_total") SELECT "e"."emp_id" AS "emp_id", "e"."emp_name" AS "emp_name", "eot"."total_amount" AS "total_amount" FROM "emp_order_total" "eot" JOIN "public"."emp" "e" ON "eot"."emp_id" = "e"."emp_id" CROSS JOIN "avg_total" "a" WHERE "eot"."total_amount" > "a"."avg_total_amount" ORDER BY "eot"."total_amount" DESC LIMIT 40
